title: unified-rollouts: integrate canary/AB/shadow autorollback with rollout workflows and observability
author: Priya Nambiar
description:
Motivation: unify automated rollback behavior across canary, A/B and shadow rollout modes and integrate those signals with the rollout orchestration engine and observability pipelines. Previous behavior had ad-hoc autorollback for canaries only; this PR extends metric-driven rollback, quarantine/probing stages, and preflight checks to A/B and shadow routes, and wires events/metrics into Console and tracing so SREs and platform owners can reason about decisions.

What changed: consolidated autorollback engine into rollout/core so the same policy config (thresholds, quarantine rules, metric quorum) applies for canary, AB and shadow. Added metric adapters for latency, error-rate and model-quality signals (per-route SLI). Implemented: 1) staged probing stage for shadow traffic with manual quarantine option; 2) composite-metric thresholds with quorum and weighting; 3) preflight probe that can be run as a dry-run before applying a rollout; 4) telemetry hooks to emit rollback decisions, quarantine events and metric deltas to Console and tracing.

Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-4821) [x] unit tests for policy evaluator [x] e2e tests for canary -> autorollback path [x] integration tests for shadow probing stage [x] observability dashboards updated [x] rollout docs updated

Testing & validation: CI runs include unit, integration and e2e with a synthetic traffic generator. Local canary runs validated rollback on injected error-rate regressions and latency spikes. We staged a rollout in staging and exercised the preflight probe and quarantine flows.

Migration notes: existing rollout configs without explicit autorollback remain unchanged; new default policy enables metric-driven autorollback with safe defaults (conservative thresholds and quarantine enabled). Operators can opt into aggressive policies via rollout.policy.

Related: addresses ENG-4821 and ENG-4910, follows up on PRs that added canary autorollback and observability hooks.
commits: a1f3b9d: refactor rollout autorollback engine into rollout/core; extract policy evaluator
b4e2c77: add composite-metric adapter and quorum logic; tests
c8d9e11: implement shadow staged probing stage with manual quarantine API
d2a7f6b: wire telemetry events (rollback/quarantine/decision) into Console/event stream
e9f4b22: update docs and add e2e tests for canary/AB/shadow autorollback scenarios
review_comments: Evan Li (reviewer): Nice consolidation. Two asks: (1) can we make the default quorum configurable per-customer? (2) add a small doc blurb explaining preflight semantics so on-call knows how to interpret dry-run failures.

Priya Nambiar (author): For (1) yes — added rollout.policy.quorum and it defaults to 3; per-customer override via tenant config is supported. For (2) added section to docs/unified-rollouts.md and Console tooltip text.

Marco Rossi (reviewer): I ran the staging experiment — observed a false-positive on the composite metric when latency noise spiked. Suggest smoothing window and add a guard to require at least N requests in the window before triggering quarantine.
Priya Nambiar (author): Added smoothing window (configurable) and min-sample-size guard. Updated tests to include noisy traces.
Sasha Patel (approver): Tests look good, observability emits are clear. Approving pending CI green.
CI bot: All checks passed on rerun.
release_notes: Unified rollouts: metric-driven autorollback for canary, A/B and shadow traffic; staged shadow probing with manual quarantine; composite-metric quorum and smoothing; preflight dry-run; observability events for rollback decisions. Operators can opt into stricter policies via rollout.policy.
tests: e2e: canary -> autorollback on injected 5xx spike and latency regressions
staging-run: preflight and quarantine manual verification
rollout_plan: Gradual rollout: enable new autorollback engine in staging for 48h, collect telemetry, enable in canary-only 25% of production routes for 72h, then enable default policy for all routes. Manual gates at each step. Rollback if any unexpected regressions observed.
observability_notes: Console dashboard 'Autorollback Overview' added; emits per-rollout decision events and metric deltas. Traces include rollout_id and decision_reason tags. Alerts for repeated quarantines added to SRE playbook.
safety_guards: Default policy conservative: min-sample-size=100, smoothing_window=30s, quorum=3, quarantine duration default 5m. Manual quarantine/override APIs exposed for operators.
notes_for_ops: If you see repeated false-positives, increase smoothing_window or min-sample-size, or set rollout.policy.mode=manual for the affected route. Contact platform-eng on-call if rollback reasons are unclear.
